PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: soul feeding
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: When a soul eater's soul saturation is low, they may drain this prisoner. Other prisoners who are soul eaters can also feed on this prisoner, if they are in the same cell.

PrisonerInteractionModeDef.label: soul farm
PrisonerInteractionModeDef.description: The operation to extract a soul fragment will be automatically queued on this prisoner whenever it can be done without killing them. The operation will be carried out by a doctor.
